utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’ll bring the latest list and keep asking around for a few more volunteers. Rosie can go over the list on Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got the supplies covered, and I’ll make sure we have what we need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Saturday at the community center is still the plan, and I noticed the west gate hinge is loose and the porch light is flickering.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’ll be there on Saturday. Sam’s checking the list, so your hinge and porch light should be covered.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Good, then we’re covered on Saturday. I’ll still keep an eye on the porch light and that loose hinge until someone gets to them.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’m covering the plumbing parts and a couple switches. If you need the posted list, ask Nell.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Gus can bring a few tools and a wrench, but we still need more basic supplies, tools, and volunteers for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Oren should have the rest of the details lined up this week, and Ira is covering the remaining parts.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Vik’s helping too. I can handle pickup if you grab the parts.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it, I’ll grab the parts and see if I can help catch up. If Gus’s wrench is free, I might need that too.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Right, I’ll keep pickup covered. If Gus’s wrench is free, take it and bring the parts over.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll keep an eye on Oren and Vik, and Rosa’s list should help keep everything on track.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Right, and Cleo's got the supplies under control, so that should keep the drive steady on Monday at the school gym.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That should keep things steady, as long as Rosa’s list stays up to date.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Rosa's got the rest ready, and Noah's on pickup and parts. Sam can take the west gate hinge and porch light.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring a few tools and lend my wrench if Noah still needs it tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: That covers it. Pia will check with Tess after lunch, and we’re set.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, I’ll touch base with Vik and make sure the repair drive details are lined up this week.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Got it, I’ll make sure Vik has what he needs and keep the repair drive moving along this week.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can help with that. I’ll make sure the drive has what it needs by tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That works. Bo can swing by after 3:30, so we should be covered on hands once he gets there.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, that gives us the staffing we need. I’ll keep making sure everything else is ready by tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Then we should lean on Noah to catch up, and I’ll keep track of the rest so nothing gets missed.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Wednesday at the fire station works for me. I’ve got the repair drive list ready, and I’ll make sure the patch list and screws are on hand.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Good, then I’ll keep an eye on the list and the parts so Wednesday stays manageable.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’ll spread the word and check who still needs a hand. Opal’s keeping track, and I’ll make sure Noah gets the timing.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’ll check the list and make sure Opal’s hinge and porch light are covered, and I’ll sort out what still needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, then I’ll make sure Noah gets the timing and keep checking who still needs a hand.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’ll post the list for the repair drive, and the drive is ready on my end. Mina has the plumbing parts and a couple of switches, and Gus is bringing the tools.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, Cleo’s keeping track of the supplies and the repair drive is covered, right?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, Cleo’s keeping track of the supplies, and the repair drive is covered on my end.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yeah, I’m sending the word around tonight and I’ll make sure everyone on my block knows the repair drive is on Saturday. Uli’s in, and I’ll check with Sam and Bo too so they’re on the list.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’ll let Mara know about the west gate hinge and the flickering porch light tonight, and she’s ready to take care of her part once the list comes through.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Sounds like we should be covered once Bo gets there after 3:30, and Oren can keep things moving this week while he checks in with Vik for the details.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’ll check the list and make sure Opal’s hinge and porch light are covered, then I’ll sort out what still needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That sounds right. I’ll keep an eye on the list and we should be in good shape once Bo is there after 3:30.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’ve got the plumbing parts and a couple of switches covered. Do we already have a posted list for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Not yet, but I can put it together now. We’ve got most of the list covered, and Bo can help after 3:30.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’ll put together the list with you. Just make sure Bo’s after 3:30 help is noted.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’ll be there on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Right, tomorrow morning. I’ll catch up and bring the wrench if Gus can lend it.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’ll check Sam has the list covered, and Noah can handle pickup.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, I’ll keep track of the supplies and make sure the repair drive is covered.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Cleo. I’ll touch base with Vik and get the repair drive details lined up this week.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, that covers us. I’ll keep an eye on the supplies until Rosa’s list comes in.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yep, I’ll spread the word tonight and make sure everyone on my block knows about Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, I’ll check who still needs a hand and let Noah know the timing too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll make sure Sam and Bo hear tonight, and I’ll tell Mara about the west gate hinge and the flickering porch light too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, Monday at the school gym is still the plan, and Vik’s helping out too. Cleo’s got the supplies sorted, so we should be in decent shape.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Right, Sunday at the community center. I’ve still got the latest list, and I’m asking around for a few more volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, right, Monday at the school gym - not Sunday. Mara’s making sure we’ve got what we need by tomorrow, so we should be set.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Good, then Noah can help catch up if we’re short-handed. I’d like to keep the patch list close so we do not miss anything.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good. I’ll keep Vik in the loop too.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Good, and I’ll keep the screws with the list so nothing gets separated.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Opal, we still need basic supplies, a few more tools, and more volunteers for the repair drive. Noah can help catch us up, and Bo will be here after 3:30.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Good to know about Gus, but we still need more tools, supplies, and a few more hands for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m helping too, and I’ll keep pushing for more tools and supplies.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’s good to hear. We still need a few more tools, basic supplies, and extra hands before the drive is covered.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Good, I have the repair drive list ready, and I’ll make sure the patch list and screws are on hand for Wednesday at the fire station.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That should cover us. I’ll keep an eye out for anything else that needs sorting before Wednesday.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Rosa's list should keep us on track, and I'll keep an eye on Oren and Vik while the repair drive moves along.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, and Cleo is keeping the supplies covered, yes?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, and with Cleo on supplies plus Rosa’s list, we should stay on track.
